items.source_sentence: Key Highlights Robinhood invested about $75 million in OpenAI, giving it a small stake in the company.

OpenAI has raised USD $122 billion in committed capital, valuing the company at USD $852 billion after the investment. The round was anchored by Amazon, Nvidia and SoftBank, with Microsoft continuing to participate as an existing backer. SoftBank co-led the financing with Andreessen Horowitz, D. E. Shaw Ventures, MGX, TPG and accounts advised by T. Rowe Price Associates.

A separate PE joint venture with TPG, Advent International, Bain Capital, and Brookfield Asset Management, valued at roughly $10 billion pre‑money, with the PE firms collectively committing around $4 billion in exchange for preferred equity stakes.
OpenAI closed $122 billion at an $852 billion post‑money valuation on March 31, 2026.
Tuesday, ChatGPT-parent OpenAI announced that its latest fundraising round received $122 billion in committed capital, making it the largest private funding round in history.

totals.note: Each matched deal record counts once, regardless of how many articles report it. Counts are measured over the entire filtered window, independent of result limits. USD amounts use fixed conversion rates, not current or transaction-date exchange rates. Only usable amounts enter sums, medians and maxima: finite, positive, converted to USD and at most 25,000,000,000 USD. Larger or unconverted figures are counted in deals_amount_excluded. Sums and medians count one company and amount once, because the same round is often reported under several round labels. Missing, zero, negative and non-finite amounts count as unknown; amount statistics are null when no matched deal has a usable amount. Deal records include equity rounds, debt facilities, placements and announced commitments. Amounts are reported figures, not independently verified financial amounts.
